title: Pricing Assist Rating Adjustment — Listing Quality Program Note for Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Pricing Assist Rating Adjustment

*Listing quality program note, Roamhaven Listings.*

The rating adjustment is a Pricing Assist adjustment, a fraction of the all-in night, worked out on the day of the request. It is read from the quality assessment recorded on the listing within the last three months (fewer than three whole months before the day of the request; assessments run quarterly, so there is at most one), using that assessment's average guest rating and the number of guest reviews it counted.

| That assessment's average rating | Guest reviews it counted | Rating adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| at least 4.80 | at least 10 | 0.04 |
| at least 4.80 | fewer than 10 | 0.02 |
| below 4.80 | any | none |
| no assessment in those three months | — | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical assessments)

| Average rating | Reviews | Rating adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 4.80 | 10 | 0.04 — both at the figure |
| 4.80 | 9 | 0.02 |
| 4.79 | 25 | none — below 4.80 |
| 4.95 | 3 | 0.02 |
